Across Acme's fleet, the average battery cycle count by device model is 948.0 cycles for the Dell XPS 15 (1 device), 879.0 cycles for the ThinkPad X1 Carbon (2 devices), and 559.2 cycles for the MacBook Pro (5 devices).

citations.label: SQL [Calculate average battery cycle count by device model for battery-present devices] (3 rows)

queries.sql: SELECT model_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(battery_cycle_count) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_battery_cycles, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = TRUE AND battery_cycle_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY avg_battery_cycles DESC LIMIT 200

args.sql: SELECT model_name, ROUND(AVG(battery_cycle_count)::numeric, 1) AS avg_battery_cycles, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM telemetry.v_latest_device_state WHERE battery_present = true AND battery_cycle_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY avg_battery_cycles DESC LIMIT 200
